title: FactoryPulse - Machine Failure
summary: A synthetic plant supervisor exercise connects machine condition, a production slowdown, rising rejects and a shipment cutoff. Compare independent evidence before choosing a response.
cause: Incorrect gain and zero coefficients on S-204 flattened displayed vibration while M-204 bearing wear increased. The degraded machine then reduced throughput and raised dimensional rejects before dispatch.
mission: Investigate the production slowdown using sensor, machine, schedule, inspection and shipment evidence. Diagnose the first failing system before the debrief and choose a safe response.
success: Inspect independent evidence, diagnose the source before reveal, protect suspect output and reduce illustrative late units versus the same-workload no-action baseline within budget.
